anomalies.expected: The specification's component-matching table states that schematic C1 belongs to the 1 µF / 25 V group ("C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V"), i.e. C1 should be 1 µF / 25 V, matching the Pervasive Displays reference circuit.

anomalies.impact: C1 is the input bypass capacitor for the EPD boost converter (the pulsed-current load of L1/Q1). Replacing the specified 1 µF with 0.1 µF reduces input filtering by 10×, which can cause rail droop / instability on the Display_Power_Switch node during display refresh and increased EMI; the 16 V rating is also below the specified 25 V (though the rail is 3.3 V, so the rating is a secondary deviation).
